name: ui-list-group
description: Bootstrap list group: links, buttons, active and disabled items, theme colours, flush, numbered, (responsive) horizontal.

descriptions.--bs-list-group-action-color: Text colour of link and button items.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-action-hover-color: Text colour of a hovered or focused link/button item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-action-hover-bg: Background of a hovered or focused link/button item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-action-active-color: Text colour of a pressed link/button item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-action-active-bg: Background of a pressed link/button item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-disabled-color: Text colour of a disabled item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-active-color: Text colour of the active item.
descriptions.--bs-list-group-active-border-color: Border colour of the active item.
